page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance built on KVM hypervisor technology. The instance features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. System memory totals 128.0 GB, providing an allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual CPU core.

The instance configuration contains no bundled local disk storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data operations. Networking capabilities are defined by an 80 Gbps baseline bandwidth capacity, enabling fast data transfer across cloud services. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not feature hardware GPU acceleration.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the hardware configuration prioritizes compute execution density over memory capacity. This core layout offers qualitative cost efficiency for CPU-bound applications that require substantial processing capacity without high memory allocation needs. However, operations requiring large in-memory caches or high-capacity local drives must account for the lack of local disk storage and the tight memory ratio.

The hardware profile suits compute-intensive workloads such as batch processing, high-performance compute worker nodes, continuous integration pipelines, and computational simulation workloads that benefit from 64 dedicated vCPUs and high baseline network bandwidth.
